title: Verify incomplete coverage metadata in OpenAQ sensor responses
problem: API #404 reports a location sensor-list request failing with HTTP 500 when a sensor lacks reporting-period metadata. A diagnostic comment lists five null coverage-field validation errors. Current runtime failure and intended database/API contract remain unverified.
humanitarian_relevance: OpenAQ supports community access to pollution measurements. Preventing a sensor metadata failure from interrupting data access could aid analysis; no affected humanitarian user, health outcome or realized benefit is established.

evidence.claim: The issue reports a location sensor-list error; a diagnostic comment attributes five response-validation errors to missing logging/averaging values and proposes requiring those values in the database.

At the pinned source revision, Sensor.coverage permits null but Coverage requires non-null numeric/string fields. The original sensor route calls calculate_coverage with reporting periods when a latest value exists. This is static source evidence, not a reproduced server error.
A synthetic response-model and route probe can distinguish valid, wholly absent and partially null coverage without querying operational data. Database invariants may ultimately be the intended fix.

code_surface: At 87c060c28f5b484e0e9953d247082f5e678935c9: openaq_api/v3/models/responses.py Coverage/Sensor/SensorsResponse; openaq_api/v3/routers/sensors.py fetch_sensors and location-sensor response validation. Existing tests/test_sensors.py and setup located; calculate_coverage database implementation remains to locate.
proposed_change: First verify the failure and intended coverage contract. If accepted, provide a focused regression and agreed handling for missing reporting metadata; do not silently invent intervals, zero coverage, or widen response nullability.
research_next_step: Inspect remaining test/setup and calculate_coverage sources, then run original response-model/route probes with synthetic valid, absent and partially null coverage. Determine database-test requirements and separate API handling from the proposed ingestion/database constraint fix before preparing an inquiry.
priority_rationale: Air-pollution burden and named OpenAQ community use motivate this research path. Select the unassigned sensor-access report over future SDK cleanup and already-owned Explorer/API fixes. No implementation priority or realized impact is implied.
tests: No target tests run. Eight source/setup files were fetched and Git-blob verified. Existing sensor smoke tests cover mixed v2/v3 endpoints but not the specific location-sensor response with null coverage fields. Proposed synthetic controls remain to execute.
environment: Python >=3.11, Pydantic >=2.11,<3 and FastAPI >=0.115.11,<0.116 declared. Database, cache and cloud dependencies are present. Test workflow paths require reconciliation with current tree before an isolated install. No clone, install, service start or live API request performed.
